lean.statement: For every normed additive group E with second-countable Borel structure, normed additive group F, measures mu and nu on E, a map g : E -> F, b in NNReal, and r in R, if g is Lipschitz with constant b, x |-> ||g x||^2 is nu-integrable, and wassersteinDistance mu nu squared is at most ENNReal.ofReal (r^2), then x |-> ||g x||^2 is mu-integrable and its mu-integral is at most twice its nu-integral plus 2*(b:R)^2*r^2.
approved_definition_context: wassersteinDistance is Samplinglib's quadratic Wasserstein distance, defined as the square root of the infimum of quadratic coupling costs.
ENNReal.ofReal embeds a nonnegative real quantity into the extended nonnegative reals.
